desc: Read input N and the list X.
Compute the list of differences $d$ where $d[i] = X[i+1] - X[i]$.
Reconstruct the new difference array `new_d` by taking elements from sorted `odds` and `evens` in alternating order.
Calculate the minimum sum using the formula: `sum = N * X[0] + sum((N - i) * new_d[i] for i in range(N-1))`.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Ensure time complexity is within limits (O(N log N)).
